title: Free passage to New York and the ship that was blown up
summary: He got a free ship passage from Oslo to New York, brought the crew to Harlem, and learned the ship was blown up on its way back with everyone lost.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: Now, what happened then, I got a note in my hotel up in Fenmark and I was lucky enough to come back to -- Oslo, and I got a ship -- it was going to America.
I think it was called the Oslo Feuer (ible), that was the name of the ship and I didn't have too much money then because you know, so, they give it gratus. They put me on the ship gratus.
Now, I'm on my way. We are coming through St. John, Nova Scotia, coming through that way. But something kept telling me, Jacques, something is wrong. I kept feeling that awful feeling, you know?
And there was a little fellow -- big man, he was a big man but I called him little because he was young. His name was Oscar Rood. (phonetic).
So, we made New York, made Brooklyn. I went to mom's house and lucky, she had a room for me. And I took the whole crew from the Oslo (Feuer), the ship, and took them up to Harlem.
Well, they fell in love with the girls in Harlem and the girls in Harlem fell in love with them.
But, when the ship left, on its way back to Norway, it was blown up and souls were lost. Everybody was lost. That was the feeling I had.
